title: etwdump: either declare functions static or declare them in headers.
description:
If a function is used only in the .c file that defines it, declare it
static.

If it's used in other .c files, don't declare it .c files that call it;
declare it in a .h files also included in the .c file that defines it.

commits_data.message:
etwdump: either declare functions static or declare them in headers.

If a function is used only in the .c file that defines it, declare it
static.

If it's used in other .c files, don't declare it .c files that call it;
declare it in a .h files also included in the .c file that defines it.
